engine_profile: UE4 (pak version 11, repak major Fnv64BugFix). Exact UE4.x minor UNKNOWN pending asset-serialized-version check.
container_type: UE4 legacy PAK (no .utoc/.ucas/.sig -> NOT IO Store)

pak_layout.header: Custom Mundfish JSON pre-header (an embedded .uproject descriptor) prepended to each .pak before the standard UE4 payload.
pak_layout.footer: Standard UE4 pak footer: magic 0x5A6F12E1 at end of file. Index is at the tail, not the head.
pak_layout.note: repak v0.2.3 parses all 19 paks successfully despite the JSON pre-header (it locates the footer magic).

notes: Values verified by direct header/index inspection (reports/game_scan.json, reports/pak_index_summary.txt). Localization format and culture details are documented in docs/LOCALIZATION_FORMAT.md and docs/ARCHIVE_LAYOUT.md.
